categories.main_business_segments: Xi'an Triangle Defense Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, sales, and service of forged parts for aerospace, aviation, and shipbuilding industries. Its main products include large-scale special alloy forgings such as aircraft structural components and engine disk parts, focusing on titanium alloys, high-temperature alloys, and high-strength steels. The company also operates subsidiaries specializing in aerospace mechanical processing and materials technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced forging technologies including 400MN large-scale precision forging hydraulic presses, 300MN isothermal forging lines, and Φ2500mm ring rolling production lines. It has developed proprietary core technologies in large-scale forging, isothermal forging, and ring rolling, supported by 12 invention patents and 19 utility model patents. R&D focuses on forging processes for high-temperature alloy turbine disks, high-strength titanium alloys, aluminum-lithium alloy forgings, and precision forging of engine blades, with continuous optimization of forging processes to improve material utilization and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are major state-owned defense and aerospace enterprises including China Aviation Industry Corporation, China Aero Engine Corporation, and China Shipbuilding Group. Its products are integrated into new generation military aircraft, transport aircraft, helicopters, and domestic aero engines. The end markets are primarily military aviation and aerospace sectors, with some civil aviation and shipbuilding applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, headquartered in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, with subsidiaries in cities such as Shenyang, Chengdu, and Shanghai. It serves domestic aerospace and defense manufacturers and is actively seeking to expand overseas markets through cooperation with international aerospace enterprises.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xi'an Triangle Defense operates primarily in the midstream segment of the aerospace and defense supply chain, specializing in the manufacturing of critical forged components for aircraft and engines. It acts as a key supplier to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and defense contractors, providing customized, high-precision forged parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in forging technologies for advanced materials such as high-temperature alloys, high-strength titanium alloys, and aluminum-lithium composites. It invests heavily in R&D to develop forging processes for next-generation aircraft components, including turbine disks, engine blades, and large structural forgings. Strategic initiatives include expanding production capacity, enhancing digital manufacturing capabilities, and participating in national aerospace projects to support new aircraft and engine development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized forged aerospace components to major defense and aerospace manufacturers. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with contracts specifying delivery schedules, prices, and quantities. It also receives government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with large state-owned aerospace forging enterprises and research institutes, which dominate the high-end military forging market due to their scale and technical strength. As a private enterprise with military production qualifications, Xi'an Triangle Defense positions itself as a specialized supplier with advanced forging technology and stable customer relationships, aiming to increase its market share in high-precision aerospace forgings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, a 30% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 380 million, down nearly 49%. Total assets reached over RMB 9.15 billion, growing 10.66% year-over-year. Despite recent revenue declines, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D, positioning for future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced forging equipment, proprietary core technologies, and strong R&D capabilities as key differentiators. Its 400MN large-scale precision forging hydraulic press is a domestic innovation that enables production of ultra-large, high-strength, and high-precision forgings, meeting stringent military standards. Long-term collaboration with major OEMs and comprehensive military production qualifications ensure product quality, reliability, and stable supply, supporting its reputation as a trusted supplier in the aerospace defense sector.
